product_family: Automated content repurposing and cross-platform distribution SaaS for creators, small businesses, e-commerce brands, and agencies. Single product line (Starter / Pro / Agency pricing tiers) that resizes, removes watermarks from, schedules, and publishes video/image/Stories content across TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, Snapchat and other social platforms.

certifications.name: SOC 2 (Type 1/2)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of SOC 2 certification found on the vendor's site (home page, Privacy Policy, or Terms of Service); no trust center exists.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 27001 certification found on the vendor's site; no trust center exists.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: The Privacy Policy does not mention GDPR, EU data subject rights, or an EU legal basis for processing anywhere in the document. The Terms of Service reference compliance with Canadian privacy law (PIPEDA) but not GDPR.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No mention of HIPAA, Business Associate Agreements, or healthcare data handling anywhere on the vendor's site. Product is a consumer/creator social-media tool, not built for regulated health data.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of PCI DSS certification. Support content indicates payment card data is handled by Stripe as payment processor rather than stored by Repurpose.io directly, which is a common and reasonable startup pattern but is not itself a PCI DSS certification held by the vendor.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI Governance)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of an AI governance certification on the vendor's domain.

certifications.name: CSA STAR / CSA STAR AI
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of CSA STAR or CSA STAR AI registration on the vendor's domain.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of FedRAMP authorization; product is not marketed to US federal agencies.

privacy.ai_training_note: Terms of Service state: 'Repurpose will not use your content for purposes such as AI training unless you explicitly opt in through a separate consent process.' There is a separate, opt-in-only 'AI Content Licensing Program': 'Opt-In Required. To participate, Users must affirmatively opt in through a clearly presented mechanism,' and by opting in a user 'grant[s] Repurpose.io and its third-party partners a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, reproduce, modify, distribute, publicly display, perform, and create derivative works of Your User Content for purposes of training artificial intelligence models and for any related lawful commercial purposes.' Default posture (no opt-in) is no AI training on customer content; the opt-in license, if taken, is very broad (perpetual, irrevocable) and worth flagging to prospective users.
privacy.data_region: Not specified on the vendor's site; no data residency or regional hosting options are documented.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: SSL encryption used to protect information transmitted through the site ('We use SSL encryption to protect sensitive information online').

security.name: Credential storage
security.value: Connected third-party platform credentials are stored encrypted in the database ('We store credentials encrypted in our database').

security.name: Account authentication
security.value: Users connect social accounts via official platform OAuth flows ('Connect with TikTok', 'Connect with YouTube') rather than sharing passwords directly with Repurpose.io; minimum 12-character password policy and forced logout of all sessions on password change, per vendor help center.

security.name: Payment data handling
security.value: No credit card data stored on Repurpose.io servers; Stripe is used as the payment processor.

security.name: Vulnerability disclosure
security.value: Security issues can be reported to support@repurpose.io for priority handling; no formal bug bounty or published disclosure policy found.

security.name: Data retention
security.value: Personal information is retained 'for the period necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this Privacy Notice unless a longer retention period is required or permitted by law.'

products.name: Repurpose.io (Starter/Pro/Agency)
products.data_scope: Uploaded/synced videos, images, Stories, and captions; connected social account OAuth tokens (TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, Snapchat, etc.); basic account/contact PII (name, email, phone, address) for billing and support.
products.notes: Single-tier product family differentiated only by number of connected social accounts and publish volume, not by security/compliance posture. No enterprise, API-only, or self-hosted tier found.

compare.pricing_model: Flat-rate subscription tiers (Starter $35/mo, Pro $79/mo, Agency $179/mo, billed monthly or yearly) based on number of connected accounts per platform; 14-day free trial.

flags: No trust center, SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI DSS, GDPR-specific, or AI-governance certification was found anywhere on the vendor's domain. This is consistent with a growth-stage consumer/SMB tool; no compliance badges are held.

Privacy Policy does not reference GDPR or EU data subject rights, and does not mention a Data Processing Agreement (DPA). GDPR posture is unconfirmed rather than compliant, even though the vendor likely has EU users.

The opt-in 'AI Content Licensing Program' grants a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide license to use content for AI model training once a user opts in. Default behavior is no training; the license terms upon opt-in are broad (perpetual, irrevocable) and the opt-in is a UI action a user could click without reading closely.
